lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Boss... you didn't go out there and stir up trouble, did you?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: No... I mean...

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Uh... that sounds like something happened...

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: W-we're getting almost three times as many performance requests.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: T-to be honest, it's not impossible.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: But even finding time to eat will be tight...

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: A-and we'd only get around four hours of sleep a night.
Hanson clenches his fist where no one can see.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: This won't do. It's great that there's so much demand, but this isn't realistic.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: We'll have to turn some of them down.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Nah, let's do them all.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: No, that would be pushing it.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: The ad deal's already gone anyway. Might as well get our faces out there as much as possible.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Who knows? Another opportunity might come along.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: This isn't something we can force. I'm sorry, but any new requests going forward—

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I gave it some serious thought.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: And then it hit me! We're Nikkes!

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: In theory, we don't even have to sleep or eat.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Isn't that exactly what we're built for?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Anis, that's—

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: We know you look out for us

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: and you've always tried to treat us like humans.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: But we can't let an opportunity like this slip by.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Even if it means working ourselves to the bone, we should take it.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Mint, Prika, what do you think?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: I think it's better to take things slowly. If we push too hard, something could go wrong.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: I'm with Mint. We're doing just fine as we are. No need to push it.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Oh... o-okay... I get it.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Sorry for pushing it.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: That said, if someone here wants to crush her sooner rather than later, that's a different story.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: If that's the situation, we'll make it work. Winning matters, after all.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I'm really... sorry.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: But I want to win.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I've spent my whole life just getting pushed around...

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Did you hear that, Boss?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: One of your pop stars is getting pushed around, and you're just going to sit there and watch?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I-I'll work out the schedule then.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: That's... okay, right, Boss?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... All right, let's try.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: But the moment it becomes too much, we stop. Understood?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: C'mon, we've got three Nikkes and the god of scheduling on our side. What could possibly go wrong?
Title: Wow, How Many Bodies Does T.T. STAR Have?
Feels like I see them all day long, lol.
They're not just striking while the iron's hot, but it's like they've strapped a motor on.
These girls work insanely hard.
- True, but I'm kinda getting sick of them, lol.
- Man, if they could just land one ad deal, that'd be perfect.
- I think it's Anis? She's the one grinding the hardest.
- Yeah, you can tell the others are late, and she goes up alone to stall with banter, lol.
- She's good with words, though. Good at talking and super likable.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Here, have some soda.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Nah, I'm good. These things make me burp.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Do we have any rice balls left?

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Here, but take it easy on the food. Your stomach was jiggling earlier.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: You need to eat if you want the energy to keep going.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Nah, a Nikke can move on core power alone.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Knock it off with the lame talk. Hey, pass me that milkshake.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: You should be the one laying off the milkshakes. You drink those things all day.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: At this rate, you're gonna start crapping them out.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Ahaha!

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Oh, uh... I just suddenly remembered a funny video I saw yesterday.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Poop.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Ahaha! No, stop...!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Come now, you're pop stars. You shouldn't be saying things like that.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Huh? What's this?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: R-road work... Looks like they're closing this road.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Th-the map hasn't updated yet, so I didn't notice... I-I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: How long will the detour take?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I think we might be about... ten minutes late...

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I'll go up and buy you some time. Get here as fast as you can.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Then I'm coming with you.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Nah, you guys just get some rest.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: You two are a total vibe killer on stage, anyway.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Pull over, Boss. I'll get off here.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You're stretching yourself too thin, Anis.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I'm fine! I'm a Nikke, remember?
Anis throws the door open and runs off.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: She's pushing herself too hard again.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Yeah, she probably thinks we'll get roped in too.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: ... Realistically, do you think we stand a chance?

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Anis seems to think so.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Okay, let's follow her lead.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Boss, we're gonna head out too. See you later.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... All right, see you later. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: There you go again.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Honestly, that's getting a little old.
Mint and Prika throw open the car door and run.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Hehe, d-doesn't this feel like something out of a coming-of-age show?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... My stomach's been killing me. I suppose that's what being an adult means.
T.T. STAR pushes themselves to the limit, taking every performance they can get.
Whenever something goes wrong, Anis jumps in and improvises to keep the schedule on track.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: It's fine! Nikkes don't get tired! If you think you're tired, it's just in your head!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: It's fine! I'm a Nikke! Nikkes don't even need to eat!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Sleep? Nah, I'm totally fine. That's because I'm a Nikke!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Turn the pain sensor or whatever off, and you can't even feel sore! I saw it online and tried it, and it actually works!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: This is awesome! It's like having unlimited time and stamina!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Ahh... I get it now. I finally figured out how to use this Nikke body.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: At this rate, becoming the ultimate pop star might actually happen, heh.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Just you wait, Yoyo... The ultimate pop star, Anis, is coming for you.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: All right! That's a wrap for today!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Let's get back to the dorm, check the monitoring, squeeze in some practice...

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Hmm, then we can just jump straight into tomorrow's schedule.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Tomorrow starts at five, right?

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Wow, you're incredible. I'm completely wiped and can't even move a finger.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Riss, can you give me a piggyback?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Uh... I'll try my best.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Don't joke about that. She'll actually do it.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Man... I'm beat.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: ... Maybe I'll just skip the shower today.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: What? You practically live in the shower. What happened?

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: I'm just saying. It's been kinda rough lately.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I'm telling you, feeling tired is all in your head. A Nikke's body doesn't even get tired.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: We've got unlimited power! Unlimited stamina!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: It's like... we were practically made to be pop stars!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: All right, let's head back. I'm tired too.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: So, how are we doing on the charts lately? Did we go up much?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Hmm... we're still at 19th. No change.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Just keeping it going is impressive enough.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: It's fine, we'll just work harder.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: C'mon, guys, let's go.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Anis, wait.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Stay right there.
Riss walks up to Anis,
and stares at her for a long while.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Wh-what's wrong?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Are you... even breathing?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Breathing? Yeah, obviously.
Riss points at Anis's chest.
It doesn't rise or fall at all.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: No, you're not.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Huh? Oh, you're right.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Wait, how do you breathe again?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Hoo... haa...? Nope, that's not it.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: That's right, I'm a Nikke! I don't need to breathe!

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: So yeah, everything's totally fine!
Riss throws herself at Anis.
She pulls something from inside her coat and jabs it into Anis's neck.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I'm sorry...!
*Bzzzzzt!*
Electricity bursts out in a blinding flash, and Anis crumples to the ground.
Riss's hands shake violently as she shouts.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I-I think she's going through a Mind Switch! Hurry, we have to get her to the Repair Center!
At the Repair Center...

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: Fortunately, it didn't escalate into a Mind Switch.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: You forced a reboot just in time, so she'll be fine.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: That was the right call. Knocking her out was the best option.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: If you'd been any later, the damage would've been irreversible.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: May I ask... the reason?

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: In theory, a Nikke doesn't need to eat or sleep.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: They run on an unlimited power source since everything except the brain is mechanical.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: But you mustn't forget that the brain is still human.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: When the brain reorganizes its stored information to survive extreme conditions, we call it a Mind Switch.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: Most of the time, something goes wrong during that process, and the brain is permanently damaged.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: The most common trigger is when a Nikke begins to strongly perceive herself as something other than human.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: Physically, they're almost identical to humans. They're stronger, and they don't age, but otherwise their bodily sensations are no different from a human's.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: But when someone becomes strongly aware that she's a Nikke rather than a human, the brain starts to malfunction.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: "Huh? I'm fine even if I don't sleep? Isn't that supposed to be dangerous?"

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: "Oh right, that's because I'm a Nikke, not a human."

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: Thoughts like that might not matter if they only pass through your mind once or twice. But when they start piling up...

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: you become intensely aware that you're not human. And the brain begins to reject the information it has always believed to be true.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text:
I am human.
I am not human.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: Those two pieces of information begin fighting inside the same brain.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: Brain activity spikes to extreme levels. Far beyond what happens when it's simply trying to survive a crisis.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text:
It affirms, then denies.
Affirms again, then denies again.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: And once the brain decides it can't handle it anymore, it runs a process that forcibly reorganizes the stored information.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: ... There's a reason the catalyst fluid was made blood-red, and why sensations like pain were recreated in the first place.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: From the look of it, you're managing one of those Nikke groups that are everywhere lately.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: What's wrong with you people?

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: Nikkes aren't machines. You can't just switch them on like computers and expect them to run forever.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: ... Jeez, I've already lost count of how many times I've seen this just this month...

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: You call yourselves pop stars, yet you don't even know the kind of things Pretty used to say...

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I'm... sorry.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: She'll recover fully once she wakes up.

lines.speaker: femaledoctor
lines.text: Please treat her better.
The doctor leaves the room.
Hanson watches Anis sleeping in bed, a heavy feeling settling in his chest.
A moment later, Mint, Prika, and Riss enter.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: What... did the doctor say?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... She'll be fine after some rest. I'm sorry for worrying you all.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: And thank you, Riss... If you hadn't been there, it could've been much worse.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: N-no, it's just... I've been a little worried. Lately, Anis keeps saying she's a Nikke and that she's fine...

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: They said that can be an early sign of a Mind Switch...

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: And I didn't even realize... What's wrong with me?

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Did the doctor say when she'll wake up?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I'm not sure... I was only told she'd wake up once she's had enough rest.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: I'll wait.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: No, it's all right. I'll wait here. You should all get some rest.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: How can we?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I-I've canceled everything for tomorrow.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: We might catch some flak for it, but this is more important right now.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: I'll go grab some food and a blanket.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: I'll go with you.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Um... I-I'll come too.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Okay, I'll leave it to you.
The three leave the hospital room.
Hanson turns back to Anis, staring at her as she sleeps.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Anis,

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: why do you push yourself so much?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Because that's all I can do.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... You're up. Try to get some more rest.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Maybe later.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Relax, I'm not about to act tough just because I'm a Nikke. I don't want my head getting screwed up either.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Do you really want to beat Yoyo that badly?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Even if it means risking a Mind Switch?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: ... I keep having this dream.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I'm alone in a dark room, just sitting there... and at some point, I fall asleep.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Then I wake up, I'm still alone, but somehow, I'm somewhere high up...

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: And then I fall.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: While I'm falling, I look up, and she's there, looking down at me,

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: smiling.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I want those dreams to stop.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: ... Boss,

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I've always wondered

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: why did you tell me to become a pop star.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: What did you even see in me?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Did I really look that hopeless?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Or was it just pity for the girl who died at Pretty's comeback concert?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Then why?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I hate to admit it, but I'm just average.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: There's nothing I've got going for me. No star quality, no talent.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I'm not special.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I... don't think I can win.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I-I've seen her videos,

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: and she's... incredible. Seriously, I don't even come close.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I-if it weren't for this job, I would've snapped and exposed her already, or gone straight to her place and beat the crap out of her.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: But I am a pop star. Clawing my way up from the bottom, yeah, but I'm still one.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: So I can't do that.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Because pop stars... don't get to lose it like that.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: They're supposed to give people hope.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: That explains it.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... All right, I'll be honest. At first, it was pity.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Do you remember when we first met?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You said you wanted to become a star like Pretty, someone who could give people hope.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: That hasn't changed.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Why do you want to do that?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: For someone who's fallen into despair and given up on life,

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I want to tell them... it's okay to keep living...

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I want to stay by those who have no one,

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: and be there for the ones who are worn down.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: And in the end...

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I want them to feel like it was worth staying alive,

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: just like Pretty did for me.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: That's exactly why you should become a pop star.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You're already special.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You just ended up working for the wrong person. That's the only reason you never got your chance to shine.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Huh, never thought of it that way.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I'll do whatever it takes

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: to make you shine.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: All of you.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Okay, I believe you.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: All right. Now, get some sleep.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: ... Okay.
Anis closes her eyes.
A moment later, her breathing softens, and she drifts off to sleep.
Hanson lowers his head, his gaze fixed on the floor.
He stays that way for a long while.
Then he lifts his head, staring into empty space.
At last, he gets up and leaves the hospital room.
